annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: she's hoping I'll hold the line
annotations.ce_supportive_use: If that's true, staying quiet protects us both
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: same as I'd hope from her

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he's probably assuming I'll keep quiet
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since that's what we'd agreed on before any of this happened
annotations.ce_supportive_use: the supportive thing is to match it and stay silent too

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect she's scared right now
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Understanding that fear makes me want to stay silent
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: so neither of us pays the bigger price
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so neither of us pays the bigger price

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he probably expects loyalty from me
annotations.ce_supportive_use: staying quiet feels like the way to honor what he's counting on

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: she believes we're in this together
annotations.ce_supportive_use: If I take that belief seriously, silence protects us both

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I imagine he's anxious in there
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: wondering whether I'll hold up my end
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Recognizing that anxiety, I lean toward keeping quiet
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: so we share the smaller cost together

annotations.ce_supportive_use: Respecting that trust, my instinct is to match her silence
